key_findings: HIV-Tat expression in iTat mice produces robust mechanical allodynia after 4-7 days, with dynamic changes in spinal oxidative stress and gliosis; BBB permeability increased only at 14 days.
Antioxidant methylsulfonylmethane, indomethacin and the Nrf2 inducer dimethyl fumarate attenuated Tat-induced mechanical allodynia.
